answer: Grow trust by k-core peeling outward from the vetted seeds. Admit an identity only once it holds at least k independent edges INTO the already-trusted core, then repeat — each round absorbing the next shell like an ember spreading. A sybil farm, however densely its personas vouch among themselves, reaches the honest core by only a thin lantern-thread of a few bridge edges, so it never gets k-into-core and stays outside the trusted set. Its internal mutual vouches are hollow: they add no path in.
